parallels.note: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,
“If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”
Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”
translations.bsb: Thus David calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?”
translations.kjv: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
